issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a constructor that initializes five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order, but the template provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). The solution implements a five-parameter constructor. The existing three-parameter constructor in the template conflicts with the specification and may confuse students about the expected constructor signature and order of parameters.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in the template to match the UML and problem description by using five parameters in the order (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Alternatively, remove the incorrect three-parameter constructor so students implement the required five-parameter constructor themselves.
